# Rentlyo — Product Reference for LLMs

> Rentlyo is a white-label property management software platform for Indian property owners with 5–50 units, created by Aaryan Gupta, sold as a one-time purchase of ₹20,000 INR with lifetime ownership and zero recurring subscriptions.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: Rentlyo
- **Official Live Website**: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/
- **Creator / Lead Engineer**: Aaryan Gupta (Portfolio: https://aryanony.pages.dev/ | LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/aryanony)
- **Direct Contact**: Phone/WhatsApp: +91 62056 50368 | Email: aaryangupta.pm@gmail.com
- **Category**: Property Management Software, Rental Ledger, Society & Tenant Companion Suite
- **Primary Market**: India (Independent Landlords, PG/Hostel Managers, Commercial Plaza Operators, Housing Societies, Godown Owners)
- **Pricing Model**: Flat ₹20,000 INR one-time purchase. No monthly fees, no per-tenant fees, no server hosting bills, no renewal costs.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter (Native Android apps for Tenant Companion and Admin Console), Google Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Messaging).
- **Backend Infrastructure Cost**: ₹0/month. Operates within Google Firebase Spark (free tier) quota (50,000 reads/day, 20,000 writes/day).
- **Verified Live Deployment**: Arya Plaza, Munger, Bihar, India (URL: https://aryaplaza.vercel.app | Case Study: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/case-study/arya-plaza-munger/).

## Architecture & Core Applications
1. **Rentlyo Tenant Companion App**: Dedicated Android mobile application for renters, shopkeepers, and hostel residents. Displays live dues, advance balance, agreement summary, installment history, sub-meter electric bills, and digital gate passes. Supports one-tap UPI payment handoff and instant WhatsApp receipt generation.
2. **Rentlyo Admin Console**: Dedicated Android mobile application for property owners, building managers, and accountants. Features unit inventory, multi-unit deal consolidation, 1-click tenant onboarding wizard, utility sub-meter calculators, maintenance request resolution, broadcast notices, and PDF/CSV/Excel statement exports.
3. **White-Label Deployment Engine**: One-click automation system syncing `client_config.json`, client logos, launcher icons, native splash screens, Firebase bootstrap, and building release APKs.

## Key Differentiators
- **One-time ownership**: ₹20,000 flat vs ₹1,499–₹3,000/month recurring SaaS fees.
- **UPI one-tap payment handoff**: Deep-links into PhonePe, Google Pay, and Paytm without payment gateway fees (0%).
- **Automated Rent Engine**: Shared calculation model computing dues, advance consumption, partial payment carryovers, and step-up escalation tiers identically across both applications.
- **Commercial & Residential isolation**: Allows shopping complexes and residential flats to coexist in the same property instance without mixed tenancy records.
- **Data Sovereignty**: Runs on the client's own Google Firebase project with zero intermediary developer servers.
